name: The Deep Forest of the White Crow

texts.desc: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "White Crow" monster from your Deck to your hand. "White Crow" Monster Cards you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your End Phase: You can Set 1 "White Crow" Trap from your Deck or GY. You can only use this effect of "The Deep Forest of the White Crow" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "The Deep Forest of the White Crow" per turn.
texts.name: The Deep Forest of the White Crow
